title: For non-carcinogenic molecules that contain both carbon and oxygen atoms, i
question: For non-carcinogenic molecules that contain both carbon and oxygen atoms, identify those with double bonds. Calculate what percentage of their total atoms are nitrogen atoms, and list the top 4 molecules by this percentage in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS nitrogen_percentage
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010 AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom AS ac
    WHERE ac.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND ac.XCL_003 = 'c'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom AS ao
    WHERE ao.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND ao.XCL_003 = 'o'
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY nitrogen_percentage DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS nitrogen_percentage
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010 AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom AS ac
    WHERE ac.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND ac.XCL_003 = 'c'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM atom AS ao
    WHERE ao.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND ao.XCL_003 = 'o'
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY nitrogen_percentage DESC
LIMIT 4

checks: Eligibility predicates (non-carcinogenic, contains carbon, contains oxygen, has double bond) are applied at the molecule level using EXISTS subqueries, preventing row multiplication in the atom join.
The measure (nitrogen percentage) is computed over all atoms (a.XCL_001) in the eligible molecules, with the numerator counting only nitrogen atoms (a.XCL_003 = 'n').
Physical field meanings are consistent with historical evidence: XCL_011 = '-' for non-carcinogenic, XCL_003 = 'c'/'o'/'n' for element symbols, XCL_006 = '=' for double bonds.
Output fields (molecule_id, nitrogen_percentage) and order (descending by percentage, top 4) match the question requirements.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS nitrogen_percentage
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND b.XCL_006 = '='
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) > 0 
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'o' THEN a.XCL_001 END) > 0
ORDER BY nitrogen_percentage DESC
LIMIT 4

FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
WHERE 
    m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM atom a2

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM atom a3 
        WHERE a3.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 
        AND a3.XCL_003 = 'O'
    )
    AND b.XCL_006 = '='
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY nitrogen_percentage DESC
